Consumer prices use 2020 = 100; when the base is revised to 2025 = 100 (results announced Dec 18, new base published Dec 31), figures for January 2025–November 2026 will change. But because shuttles switch off AIS, they barely show up in IMF PortWatch's public transit count (0.4 tankers a day on Oct 1–18). Aramco did not respond to requests for comment.
전쟁 전에는 구매국 유조선이 걸프 안 항구에서 직접 실었다. 지금은 셔틀: Before the war, buyers' tankers loaded directly at ports inside the Gulf. Now shuttle tankers slip out of the strait at night with AIS off and transfer their cargo to other ships in the Gulf of Oman. The US military has reportedly helped with transfers since early May and provided air cover along the Omani coast (Al Jazeera, WSJ). After the East-West pipeline was hit in September, Saudi Arabia increased exports from the Gulf side and set October term allocations to Europe at zero (Bloomberg).

The standard route to Taiwan's CPC and Formosa refineries.

원래 얀부 화물이 북쪽으로 가는 길은 유럽행이었다. 지금은 아시아행 사우: Yanbu cargoes heading north used to be bound for Europe. Now Saudi crude for Asia also goes north this way and sails around Africa.

With new Iranian crude cut off by the US blockade, only about 9 million barrels of remaining stock were transferred in September, leaving 10 million barrels or less (UANI). After a crackdown by Malaysian authorities in September, more than 25 shadow-fleet ships left and about 20 remain.

The evidence comes from US (counterpart) sanctions documents and analysis by trackers such as UANI and Kpler; ships switch off AIS at night to transfer cargoes, so the trail ends here. On May 2 China's commerce ministry called US sanctions on Chinese companies over Iranian crude 'unilateral sanctions without UN authorisation' and issued a blocking order barring their application in China. Industry sources say Venezuelan crude was also once relabelled as Malaysian or Brazilian (Reuters, January), but no 2026 volumes have been confirmed.
